title: A waitlist signup does not enter the queue until its email is confirmed
description:
**Phase 1 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the survey submission story
- **Runs in parallel with:** the duplicate story
- **Unblocks:** scoring, in the triage epic

---
An unauthenticated public endpoint accepts whatever it is given. Confirmation is what separates a real lead from a typo or a bot, and it is the gate the operator queue counts on.

The confirmation email is also the first thing Anthus ever sends these people, so it carries the pitch: what happens next, roughly when, and the offer of a call for anyone who wants to skip ahead.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text:
Feature: Waitlist survey submission

  Scenario: An unconfirmed signup is not queued
    Given a waitlist signup that has not been confirmed
    When an operator lists the waitlist queue
    Then that signup is not in the queue

  Scenario: Confirming the email queues the signup
    Given a waitlist signup that has not been confirmed
    When the visitor follows the confirmation link
    Then that signup is in the queue

comments.text: Closed as obsolete in this repo (board cleanup 2026-10-20). The waitlist, survey and contact intake moved to the private repo AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web (PR 24, merged; its own Lambda, DynamoDB table and SES, live since 2026-10-15). The Python control plane this ticket targeted was removed here (PR 467).  GET /waitlist/confirm there confirms the email and triages once; unconfirmed signups are not queued.
